headline: Reserve Bank of India Announces Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India will conduct an Overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction on November 26, 2026, to manage liquidity conditions in the near term.
why: Central bank liquidity operations are essential for maintaining stability in short-term interest rates and ensuring the smooth functioning of the domestic banking system.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Liquidity management affects the short-term cost of capital and currency valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Changes in banking system liquidity directly influence overnight interbank lending rates, which are a benchmark for the broader economy.
